verdict.rationale: Trilegal is an Indian full-service law firm, a professional-services provider rather than a software product, so bulk operations across many items is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows legal practice pages, a knowledge repository, an llms.txt file and a compliance assessment tool, but nothing indicating the firm ships software with item-level bulk operations. The OpenAPI probe returned 404s, which is consistent with this.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
